title: Zeus Juice Dragons Claw E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Dragon’s Claw by Zeus Juice is an incredibly juicy fruit vape that balances complex layers of sweet, succulent grapes and tropical dragonfruit with an invigorating jolt of aniseed and menthol for a subtle lick of fire and ice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
